# context-inbox

> An agent reads new chat messages, drafts cited changes for Linear, Attio and GitHub, and writes each one only after a person approves it on a claude.ai review page.

A run serves one project. The project's `config.json` and `RULES.md` live in a separate private repo. The agent follows AGENTS.md and reads and writes the review page through the ArtifactData tool.

## Run

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the daily run, step by step, and the review page collections.
- [RULES.md](RULES.md): what a proposal is, how to write it, and its JSON shape.
- [config.example.json](config.example.json): the shape of a project's config.

## Destinations

- [destinations/linear.md](destinations/linear.md): issues and comments through the Linear connector.
- [destinations/attio.md](destinations/attio.md): deal notes and tasks through the Attio connector.
- [destinations/github.md](destinations/github.md): one commit per item to a docs repo.

## Code

- [scripts/sources/slack.py](scripts/sources/slack.py): reads Slack messages newer than each channel's cursor, thread replies included.
- [review.html](review.html): the review page.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): setup and config reference for people.
